 Coming into this weekend’s fixtures three points behind leader Barcelona, Real boss José Mourinho will likely have been rueing the recent domestic pause. The window interrupted a superb run of results that saw Los Blancos chalk up eight wins on the spin.
 They welcome a midtable Celta Vigo team to the Bernabéu that has been steady if unspectacular so far this term. While resilient in defense, Os Celestes have scored just 10 goals in La Liga this season, making their 5-0 thrashing of Salamanca in the Copa del Rey last weekend something of a shock.
 More from CNET
 Real Madrid takes on Celta Vigo on Saturday, Nov. 21, at the Santiago Bernabéu, with kickoff set for 9 p.m. CET . That makes it a 3 p.m. ET or 12 p.m. PT start in the US and Canada, an 8 p.m. GMT kickoff in the UK, and a 7 a.m. AEDT kickoff in Australia on Sunday.
 How to watch Real Madrid vs. Celta Vigo in the US without cable
 ESPN once again has the rights to La Liga and is showing all 380 matches on its streaming service, including today’s game.
 ESPN Plus 
 Watch La Liga soccer in the US from $14 a month 
 ESPN Select 
 Get it now 
 See at ESPN 
 Expert Take 
 ESPN’s streaming platforms have changed. The sports network now offers two tiers with its direct-to-consumer setup: ESPN Select and ESPN Unlimited. 
 ESPN Select will give you streaming access to every La Liga match this season for $14 per month.
 However, if you want La Liga plus everything the network offers online, then you’ll want to go for ESPN Unlimited, which costs $32 a month and carries content from ESPN, ESPN2, ESPN3, ESPNews, and ESPN Deportes.
 Livestream Real Madrid vs. Celta Vigo in the UK
 Premier Sports is the home for the lion’s share of Spanish top-flight matches in the UK, with the network showing 340 fixtures live once again this term, and roughly nine of the 10 matches each matchweek. Today’s match is set to be shown exclusively live on Premier Sports 1. 
 Premier Sports 
 Watch La Liga in the UK from £14 
 Premier Sports 
 Get it now 
 See at Premier Sports 
 Expert Take 
 A subscription to Premier Sports costs £14 a month for a 12-month minimum term via Sky TV, £19 for a standard monthly subscription or £16 per month via Virgin Media.
 This gives you access to all of the network’s channels, including its dedicated La Liga TV channel. The network also has UK broadcast rights to select Scottish Premiership matches, the BKT United Rugby Championship, the Investec Champions Cup, NHL and NASCAR.
 Livestream Real Madrid vs. Celta Vigo in Canada
 TSN is once again the rights holder for live coverage of La Liga matches in the region, with select fixtures shown on its linear channels and a wider selection of games on its streaming platform. TSN Plus is no longer available as a stand-alone streaming option. Viewers can now choose from two main monthly plans: TSN Standard for $25, or TSN Premium for $30. Bundles and annual subscriptions are also available. You can subscribe to TSN Premium to watch every match this season.

 Livestream Real Madrid vs. Celta Vigo in Australia
 Footy fans Down Under can once again watch La Liga fixtures live on beIN Sports, which holds the live broadcast rights in Australia for Spanish top-flight matches, with this match being shown on beIN Sports 3.
